# Price strip (`price-strip`)

Hourly energy prices as columns with the current hour marked and the cheapest window highlighted.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createPriceStrip` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/priceStrip.d.ts`): `.mh-price-strip`: energy prices per slot as columns coloured low, mid or high within the day's range, the slot running now outlined and the cheapest run of slots ahead (default three) shaded behind, with its times and average in the head. Negative prices hang below a zero line.

```ts
export function createPriceStrip(options: PriceStripOptions): PriceStripHandle;

export interface PriceStripOptions {
  /** The slots in time order (hours, half hours). */
  prices: readonly PriceSlot[];
  /** What it shows (default "Energy prices"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Index of the slot running now; earlier ones are dimmed. */
  current?: number;
  /** Length of the cheapest window to find, in slots (default 3; 0 for none). */
  window?: number;
  /** The first slot the window may start at (default the current one, or the first). */
  windowFrom?: number;
  /** After the prices in the text ("/kWh"); the columns show numbers only. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Formats prices (default two decimals). */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Show every n-th label; default 1 up to 12 slots, then every third. */
  labelEvery?: number;
  /** Shown after the last slot's start, as the end of a window that runs to the end ("24:00"). */
  end?: string;
  size?: ChartSize;
  labels?: Partial<PriceStripLabels>;
}

export interface PriceStripHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown. */
  update(options: PriceStripOptions): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface PriceStripLabels {
  now: string;
  /** Before the cheapest window's times ("Cheapest"). */
  cheapest: string;
  average: string;
  low: string;
  high: string;
  noData: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createPriceStrip } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const today = [
  0.31, 0.29, 0.24, 0.18, 0.15, 0.14, 0.17, 0.26, 0.34, 0.33, 0.27, 0.22,
  0.19, 0.16, 0.13, 0.12, 0.18, 0.29, 0.41, 0.44, 0.38, 0.32, 0.28, 0.25,
];

const strip = createPriceStrip({
  label: 'Electricity prices today',
  prices: today.map((value, hour) => ({ label: String(hour), name: `${hour}:00`, value })),
  // The slot running now; the cheapest three hours from here on are shaded.
  current: new Date().getHours(),
  unit: '/kWh',
  end: '24:00',
});

document.body.append(strip.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { PriceStrip } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const TODAY = [
  0.31, 0.29, 0.24, 0.18, 0.15, 0.14, 0.17, 0.26, 0.34, 0.33, 0.27, 0.22,
  0.19, 0.16, 0.13, 0.12, 0.18, 0.29, 0.41, 0.44, 0.38, 0.32, 0.28, 0.25,
];
const SLOTS = TODAY.map((value, hour) => ({ label: String(hour), name: `${hour}:00`, value }));

export function PriceStripExample() {
  return (
    <PriceStrip
      label="Electricity prices today"
      prices={SLOTS}
      // The slot running now; the cheapest three hours from here on are shaded.
      current={new Date().getHours()}
      unit="/kWh"
      end="24:00"
    />
  );
}
```
